questions.stem: Which antibody-synthesizing connective tissue cell exhibits a distinctive 'cartwheel' chromatin arrangement?
Brown adipose tissue generates metabolic heat in newborn infants due to high mitochondrial density expressing:
Transverse Volkmann's canals in compact bone function to connect adjacent:
options: B) Haversian canals with periosteal blood vessels
questions.answer: B) Haversian canals with periosteal blood vessels
questions.explanation: Volkmann's canals connect Haversian canals together.

questions.stem: During skeletal muscle contraction, which band length remains CONSTANT while I-band shortens?
questions.explanation: A-band represents myosin length and remains constant.

questions.stem: Which CNS neuroglial cell extends perivascular feet to form the protective Blood-Brain Barrier (BBB)?
Sensory pseudounipolar neurones featuring a single nerve process that divides into two branches reside in:
questions.explanation: Pseudounipolar sensory neurones reside in spinal DRG.

questions.stem: Which structural tissue layer encloses an individual muscle axon or myocyte fibre bundle?
Saltatory nerve impulse conduction leaps along myelinated axolemma specifically at:
questions.explanation: Depolarization jumps from one Node of Ranvier to the next.

questions.stem: Which intracellular structure is strictly ABSENT inside the axon hillock and axoplasm of a motor neurone?
questions.explanation: Nissl's granules are absent in axon hillock and axon.

questions.stem: Which blood coagulation factor acts as an anticoagulant inhibitor preventing intra-vascular clotting in health?
questions.explanation: Heparin produced by mast cells is a natural anticoagulant.
